name: End table
spec: Espresso · built from a 2-page paper manual · sizes estimated

steps.title: Screw mini fix bolts into the top
steps.text: Lay top panel A with its unfinished surface up. Screw the four mini fix bolts (5) into its holes with a screwdriver.

steps.title: Press in the mini fix caps
steps.text: Press two mini fix caps (4) into the holes near the top of each side panel C. The arrow on each cap must point outward, toward the top edge.

steps.title: Insert the dowels
steps.text: Push two dowels (2) into the holes in the top edge of each side panel C.

steps.title: Hammer in the nail legs
steps.text: Tap two nail legs (3) into the bottom edge of each side panel C with a hammer.

steps.title: Stand up the left side panel
steps.text: Stand the left side panel C on its back edge with the caps facing in.

steps.title: Attach both shelf panels
steps.text: Fit both shelf panels B against the left side panel, with the unfinished surfaces as shown.

steps.title: Screw the shelves to the left side
steps.text: Drive four chipboard screws (1) through the left side panel into the shelf ends with a screwdriver.

steps.title: Attach the right side panel
steps.text: Fit the right side panel C onto the free ends of both shelves, caps facing in.

steps.title: Screw the shelves to the right side
steps.text: Drive four chipboard screws (1) through the right side panel into the shelves with a screwdriver.

steps.title: Stand the unit upright
steps.text: Turn the unit up so it stands on its nail legs.

steps.title: Fit the top and lock the caps
steps.text: Lower top panel A onto the side panels so the bolts and dowels drop into their holes. Turn each mini fix cap (4) with a screwdriver to lock the bolts.

steps.title: Slide in the bin
steps.text: Unfold the non-woven bin (6), set its bottom board inside, and slide it onto the middle shelf.

notes: Overall size estimated at about 40 x 45 x 40 cm (W x H x D). Panel thickness is taken as 1.2 cm.
The side panels are estimated at 43.5 x 36 cm. The shelves are estimated at 33 x 34 cm and set back about 2 cm at the front. The top overhangs about 2 cm on every side.
Shelf heights are estimated: the middle shelf sits about 17 cm below the top to hold the bin, and the bottom shelf is about 6 cm off the floor.
The bin is modelled as a 31 x 16 x 32 cm fabric box. The manual's unfolding and its loose base board are simplified into one slide-in step.
The panels show no finish. Espresso (black-brown) is assumed.
Steps 3-4 show the panels standing on edge, so the frame is built lying on its back. Front-up versus front-down is a guess. Step 5's 'Upright the unit' is shown as a quarter-turn flip.
Positions are estimated for the mini fix bolts, caps and dowels. Dowels are assumed to sit in the top edges of the side panels, matching holes under the top. Caps sit about 2.5 cm below the top edge.
Step 2 is drawn for one side panel, but the hardware list (4 of each) shows it applies to both. It is split into caps, dowels and nail legs.
Steps 3 and 4 are each split into placing the panels and driving the screws. Screw spacing is estimated.
Locking the mini fix caps in step 5 is folded into the step that places the top. The manual doesn't show turning the top panel finished side up before fitting it.
The manual gives no wall-fixing steps. Maximum load is 15 lb on the top and on the middle shelf.
